"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party is committed to equal opportunity for all Americans and to making sure that every American is treated equally under the law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party is committed to ensuring full equality for women.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party reaffirms support for the Equal Rights Amendment.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
